meta.title: Alappuzha Floods · Village Prototype
meta.boundarySource: Survey of India Kerala village boundary layer; current vintage, 2018 match unverified
meta.notice: Presentation prototype. Village boundaries are sourced; every 2018 village impact index, post count, author count, baseline and candidate score below is synthetic scenario data, not an observed finding.
meta.method: Illustrative comparison of modeled impact need with simulated observed local voices, adjusted against a simulated pre-event baseline.
scenarioRules: Synthetic baseline authors/day are generated deterministically and are not observed platform activity.
Synthetic expected event voices = baseline authors/day × (1 + 1.8 × modeled impact index) × a 5-day illustrative window.
Synthetic observed voices use a deterministic activity multiplier that partly varies with a synthetic digital-access proxy.
Illustrative gap score = modeled impact index × (1 − simulated observed/expected voices), scaled 0–100.
Candidate rule for this demo: impact index ≥75 and simulated observed voices ≤40% of modeled expectation; not a calibrated threshold.
